command.editor: Send the link under the cursor or selected
ribbon: Send a video link to Clipverb
modal.title: Send a video link to Clipverb
outcome.sent: Sent to Clipverb. It files the note in the vault folder chosen in the app.
outcome.no_code: Paste the pairing code from the Clipverb app into this plugin's settings first.
outcome.no_link: No link under the cursor or in the selection.
outcome.not_running: Clipverb did not answer. Open the Clipverb app, or get it at clipverb.app.
outcome.bad_code: Clipverb did not accept the pairing code. Copy it again from the app's Browser fetcher tab.
outcome.not_bought: Buy Clipverb to keep filing notes from video links. The app shows how.
outcome.bad_link: That is not a video link Clipverb can read.
outcome.no_model: Choose a model on Clipverb's Captions + distill tab, or set this plugin to Captions only.
outcome.consent: Open Clipverb and allow it to send captions to your AI provider, then send the link again.
outcome.starting: Clipverb is still starting. Try again in a moment.
outcome.failed: Clipverb could not take the link. Paste it into the app instead.
settings.about: Clipverb is a paid desktop app with a 30-day trial. This plugin is free and talks only to the app on this computer.
settings.code.name: Pairing code
settings.code.desc: In the Clipverb app, open the Browser fetcher tab and press Copy pairing code, then paste it here.
settings.mode.name: Mode
settings.mode.desc: What Clipverb does with a link you send.
settings.check.name: Connection status
settings.check.desc: Ask the Clipverb app whether it takes this pairing code.
